exposure: Fecal carriage of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing Enterobacterales (ESBL-E)
cohort: The study included very preterm inborn infants of <= 32 weeks gestational age, comparing those with ESBL-E positive stool cultures (cases) to 1:1 matched controls tested negative for ESBL-E.
finding: There was no evidence that preterm infants colonized with ESBL-E in the stool were at higher risk for definite necrotizing enterocolitis.
birth_weight: Matched for birth weight, but no specific range provided.
